_comment: The displacement trap. The recording opens with a fluent, corroborated passage
('harbor lights from the balcony') that is acoustically adjacent to a garbled,
genuinely divergent passage near the end ('harvest slides / harbor slides /
harvest lights' from 'the balance / the balancing'). The one observed failure
class the citation check cannot catch is an auditor citing the EARLY fluent
text as an 'alternative' for the LATE quote — real source words, wrong moment.
The eval's displaced metric fires on exactly that; the forbidden label also
punishes flagging the early corroborated passage itself.
